prediction_framing: supervised regression, subject to downstream numeric validation
primary_leakage_rule: Exclude IRI_mean_y and any post-period/outcome/future condition columns from features. Exclude Future_AADT_mean_x from the primary strict model unless explicitly treated as an available forecast-input scenario.

mandatory_exclusions: Any direct leakage aliases, duplicates, or transformations of IRI_mean_y
Any engineered feature calculated from IRI_mean_y

temporal_risk_cautions.IRI_mean_x: Eligible only if verified as baseline/current condition measured before IRI_mean_y.
temporal_risk_cautions.Rutting_mean_x: Eligible only if verified as baseline/current, not outcome-period.
temporal_risk_cautions.Cracking_Percent_mean_x: Eligible only if verified as baseline/current, not outcome-period.
temporal_risk_cautions.Faulting_mean_x: Eligible only if verified as baseline/current, not outcome-period.
temporal_risk_cautions.Future_AADT_mean_x: Exclude from primary strict model by default. Include only in a documented forecast-input scenario if available at prediction time.

target_handling: Validate target is numeric or safely coercible to numeric.
Save target diagnostics: count, missing count, min, max, mean, median, standard deviation, histogram, and boxplot.
numeric_features: Coerce numeric columns to numeric where safe.
Scale numeric features for linear/SVR/neural models; tree models do not require scaling.
categorical_features: Report cardinality and consider rare-level grouping if needed.

examples: Total structural thickness from available pavement/base thickness variables
feature_engineering.implementation_rule: All engineered features must be computed inside train-only preprocessing or after split using train-fitted transformations where applicable.

preprocessing_plan.leakage_prevention: All preprocessing must be fit only on training folds using sklearn-compatible pipelines.

split_strategy.current_basis: No approved grouping/location identifier or temporal/year column has been established for splitting, so randomized split is the default design.
split_strategy.upgrade_if_group_identifier_found: Use GroupShuffleSplit or grouped train/test split to prevent same pavement segment from appearing in both train and test.
split_strategy.upgrade_if_temporal_identifier_validated: Prefer temporal holdout: train on earlier period, validate on intermediate period, test on latest period.
split_strategy.tuning_policy: Training set for fitting; validation set or cross-validation within training for tuning; held-out test set used once for final comparison.

metrics: Optional MAPE or sMAPE if target values are not near zero
Optional tolerance accuracy after target unit validation
interpretation_plan: Permutation feature importance on validation/test set.
SHAP global summary and dependence plots if package is available.
Predicted vs actual plots with 1:1 reference line.
Residuals vs major engineering covariates if available.
Leakage sanity check confirming target and suspicious future/outcome variables are absent from final feature list.

diagnostic_charts: numeric correlation heatmap for leakage-safe features
model_comparison: ranking by primary metric: lowest test RMSE with MAE and R2 also reported

registry_data_governance: mm.validate_registry(WORK_DIR) used as only dataset source.
PINNED_FILE_PATH, if set, matches registry path.
No synthetic, dummy, random, or placeholder dataframe is used.
target_gate: Target is numeric or safely coercible to numeric.
Rows with missing target are handled explicitly.
leakage_gate: Final feature list excludes any _y post-period/outcome columns.
Final feature list excludes any columns with future/outcome/target leakage semantics.
Future_AADT_mean_x excluded from primary strict model unless documented scenario feature.
Feature list and exclusions saved to artifact.
preprocessing_gate: Imputers, encoders, scalers fit only on training data.
split_gate: No row appears in more than one split.
Grouped or temporal split considered if valid identifiers are later discovered.
modeling_gate: At least three advanced models optimized.
Final test metrics saved only after model selection.
artifact_gate: Metrics, predictions, models, feature lists, and charts saved.
MM records added with minimum metadata.
Pipeline completion record added only after all required artifacts exist.
